About the Portal

Most genome-wide association studies test only the additive model for genetic association, missing associations for variants that follow non-additive inheritance models. The Non-Additive Genetic Effects Knowledge Portal is an in-development effort to represent genetic associations that were discovered using recessive, dominant, heterodominant, and genotypic association models. Additive model results are also included in NAGEKP to provide context.

About the project

The Non-Additive Genetic Effects Knowledge Portal (NAGEKP) framework is being developed by a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard. 

We welcome contributions of data and the involvement of interested researchers in collaborations on analyses, methods, or tool development. Please contact us for more information.

Getting started

Are you interested in what human genetics can tell you about your favorite gene, but not sure where to start in the NAGEKP? We've outlined a workflow that can help you assess the weight of genetic evidence for involvement of a gene in a biological process. See the workflow in a step-by-step guide or in this brief video.
